parameters.name: Bucket
parameters.description: The data cache bucket. The default value is default.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique value from your client. This value must be unique for different requests. The value can contain only ASCII characters and must be no more than 64 characters long. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).

parameters.name: Path
parameters.description: The directory of the data cache in the virtual host.
